text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature has received a fan letter and one thousand origami cranes, which I give to her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I mean, seriously, this fan made a thousand origami cranes for a side character like me…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: One thousand. Can you imagine how long it must've taken?
choice_data_list: That's just how dedicated they are to supporting you.
That's just how dedicated they are to supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …I know. And it's not like I don't appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess it's time to head to training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She carefully arranges the origami cranes on the window and we head off to training.
